name: Kyaroro
source:
Former assassination target with a priority number of 166 and is working for the Maya Union.
A girl with an extraordinary ability to survive. She's actually two entities living in symbiotism with each other, Miminzo being a parasite of alien origin.
[spoiler]She was thought to have immediately died when Mezaroa cut off her neck but survived thanks to Miminzo-tan.
The Royal Slaves caught her once again when she tried to save Renko, but after Ariari disrupted their escape attempt, she was thrown outside the window with full force by Ariari and haven't reappeared since.[/spoiler]
